title: Team
description: Sports team with name, sport, league, founding year, location, stadium, coach, win/loss/draw records, and logo. Used for sports databases, team management, and sports analytics platforms.

sport.description: Sport the team plays (e.g., Football, Basketball, Soccer)

league.description: League or competition the team participates in

founded.description: Year when the team was founded

city.description: City where the team is based

country.description: Country where the team is located

stadium.description: Name of the team's home stadium or arena

coach.description: Full name of the team's head coach

wins.description: Total number of wins in the current season or all-time

losses.description: Total number of losses in the current season or all-time

draws.description: Total number of draws or ties in the current season or all-time

logo.description: URL to the team's logo image
